scope: exploratory analysis of uploaded H-L conductor ratings; no deployment verdict
model: Bradley-Terry on original nine log-knob differences; no intercept; ridge lambda 1.0 fixed from existing fitter
validation: five folds of canonical song groups, deterministic seed 0; no pair/song crosses folds; labels not used to construct folds
exclusions: brightness foils excluded from fit/CV and counted separately; ties reported but excluded from binary fit; duplicate rater/pair rows rejected
uncertainty: 2000 song-cluster bootstrap draws of fixed out-of-fold correctness; conditional intervals do not retrain model
gates: Preserve n>=200 and accuracy>0.60; fresh preference and BAS gates remain unmeasured. Fitted knobs are exploratory candidates only.
